subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt five core memory role slots and per-agent role overrides as a permanent public plugin/config contract, rather than solve composition through existing plugin seams or a narrower recall-only contract?
rationale: This changes the durable plugin taxonomy, public configuration surface, runtime routing, and upgrade model; code review cannot choose the long-term product contract safely.

options.title: Sponsor canonical role slots
options.body: Approve the multi-role direction, but require canonical runtime reads only, Doctor-owned legacy migration, and a narrowed follow-up patch with explicit plugin role contracts.

options.title: Limit scope to recall composition
options.body: Keep the current exclusive model for non-recall behavior and design only the smallest missing recall/plugin API needed for the demonstrated use cases.

options.title: Route optional composition to plugins
options.body: Keep core memory selection singular and ask plugin owners to compose through existing plugin and SDK seams unless a concrete missing core API is demonstrated.

recommendation.title: Sponsor canonical role slots
recommendation.body: Approve the multi-role direction, but require canonical runtime reads only, Doctor-owned legacy migration, and a narrowed follow-up patch with explicit plugin role contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR explicitly routed the architecture proposal to this contact, and the unresolved question is product-level core taxonomy.
